title: Localization and total-limit assembly from strict witnesses
statement: Fix l,E,L,iota,W and coefficient system calculi SE,SL, normalized Roos models rhoE,rhoL, a normalized scalar model SY, and tensor models TE,TL as in the tensor limit-square statement. Let α be any derived natural isomorphism satisfying DerivedSigmaModel for SE and SL. For integral constructible M,N and a completeness proof for their completed E tensor, the composite of scalarTensorCompleted, TL.realization and the total limit of the SL tensor of the two scalarReduction maps equals SY.realization followed by the total limit of sequence scalar applied to tensorReduction_E and then α. This is the localization and total-limit transport step; finite strict tensor balancing is contained in the hypothesis DerivedSigmaModel. Assume in addition that every good cochain pair admits a StrictTensorWitness with the corresponding pair of complexes. Then the displayed completed total-limit equality holds.

proof.text: Use the strict witnesses on simultaneous good representatives. Naturality of the Roos bridge and completion maps transports the strict equation through localization.
Apply functoriality of realization and the coefficient sequence total limit to obtain the displayed equality.

theorem scalarTowerTensorLimitSquare_of_strictWitnesses (W : Scheme.{u})
    (SE : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus.{u, u} l E W)
    (SL : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus.{u, u} l L W)
    (ρE : IntegralComparisonRoosModel.{u, u} l E W)
    (ρL : IntegralComparisonRoosModel.{u, u} l L W)
    (SY : IntegralComparisonScalarModel.{u, u} l E L ι W SE ρL)
    (TE : TensorModel l E W SE ρE) (TL : TensorModel l L W SL ρL)
    (_hl : IsUnit (l : Γ(W, ⊤)))
    (M N : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E W)
    (hT : IsSfDerivedComplete l E W
      ((integralCompletedTensor.{u, u} l E W).obj (M.obj, N.obj)))
    (α : SE.systemClosed.tensor ⋙ integralComparisonDerivedSequenceScalar.{u, u} l E L ι W ≅
      (integralComparisonDerivedSequenceScalar.{u, u} l E L ι W).prod
        (integralComparisonDerivedSequenceScalar.{u, u} l E L ι W) ⋙ SL.systemClosed.tensor)
    (hstrict : ∀ (P Q : Complex l E W) (hP : Good l E W P) (hQ : Good l E W Q),
      ∃ w : StrictTensorWitness l E L ι W SE SL α, w.P = P ∧ w.Q = Q) :
    (scalarTensorCompleted l E L ι W M.obj N.obj M.property.1 N.property.1 hT).hom ≫
        TL.realization.hom.app
          ((integralScalarExtension.{u} l E L ι W).obj M.obj,
            (integralScalarExtension.{u} l E L ι W).obj N.obj) ≫
        (coefficientSequenceLimit.{u, u} l L W).map
          (SL.systemClosed.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom
            (scalarReduction l E L ι W SE SL ρL SY M.obj)
            (scalarReduction l E L ι W SE SL ρL SY N.obj))) =
      SY.realization.hom.app
          ((integralCompletedTensor.{u, u} l E W).obj (M.obj, N.obj)) ≫
        (coefficientSequenceLimit.{u, u} l L W).map
          ((integralComparisonDerivedSequenceScalar.{u, u} l E L ι W).map
            (tensorReduction l E W SE ρE TE M.obj N.obj) ≫
          α.hom.app (SE.reduction.obj M.obj, SE.reduction.obj N.obj))
